name: db-migrate
scope: First-party forward-only migration CLI; corresponding-source closure includes 00001-00074. Both architecture archives rebuilt in network-none containers from empty module/build caches, byte-identical to admitted binaries. Exact offline amd64 CLI exercised fresh 1-to74 and existing-data 72-to73-to74, retry/lower-target no rollback and negative-target refusal, on isolated PostgreSQL. Uses current formal opsctl database-login bootstrap, which grants schema creation only to schema_owner. Native arm64 SQL execution and full Bundle installation are not claimed; historical native arm64 evidence remains separate.
